title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Cherry Ice from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range balances the rich sweetness of dark Cherry with a brisk, cooling exhale. The result is a fruit-and-ice flavour thats refreshing without being overpowering, offering a smooth and well-rounded vape. Each refill pack includes a 2ml transparent pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a matching 2ml refill container, giving you up to 2,000 puffs of MTL satisfaction. COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil technology ensures consistent performance and flavour clarity with every puff. Thanks to the pods transparent design, its easy to keep track of e-liquid levels, and the snap-fit system ensures fuss-free use with the Dojo Blast 2000 Go device. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
